mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs, which negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points within a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between UNRATE changes and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of periods following a GDP decline, or GDP declines do not precede significant negative SPX returns (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in a month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between INDPRO drops and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 5% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) decreases by more than 100,000 in a month, it signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 5% and PAYEMS drops > 100k in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint condition does not precede significant negative SPX returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% in a month signals increased demand and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between HOUST increases and SPX returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% in a month, it signals inflationary pressure without tight monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 2% and CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5% in 1 month
regime_hint: inflationary pressure with accommodative monetary policy
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint condition does not precede significant positive SPX returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in retail and food services sales (RSAFS) by more than 5% in a month signals a contraction in consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between RSAFS decreases and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).
